name: opsflow
description: Garment Order Control Centre — replaces the Excel order follow-up workbook

scripts.build: npm run build -w @opsflow/shared && npm run build -w @opsflow/server && npm run build -w @opsflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @opsflow/shared && npm run test -w @opsflow/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @opsflow/server" "npm run dev -w @opsflow/web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @opsflow/shared && npm run db:up && sleep 5 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
